title: Make the hands good by what they serve
summary: The shabad blesses hands when they write praise and feet when they walk the Lord’s way.
takeaway: Give your hands one task that can count as praise.
lifeApplication: Before the next task, ask whether your hands are serving praise or vanity; then choose the work that leaves less stain behind.

source.shortMeaning: Hands become good when they are used for the Lord’s praise, and feet become beautiful on the Lord’s path.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next task, ask whether your hands are serving praise or vanity.
